about_the_game:
Select a band of fearless adventurers from a roster of hardened warriors and cunning specialists. Each unit brings unique strengths, but only a well-balanced party will survive the Warlock's minions and deadly traps. Choose wisely—the fate of the Talelands depends on you.

Dive into the Warlock’s shifting labyrinth, where every corner hides deadly surprises and valuable treasures. No two runs are the same—procedural generation ensures infinite possibilities, from twisted corridors to sprawling caverns.

Shape your party to match your strategy. Equip your warriors with powerful gear, discover how to best employ them for battle, and recruit specialists to adapt to the maze’s escalating challenges. The Warlock doesn’t play fair—neither should you.

Face deadly adversaries in brutal turn-based battles. Outsmart ruthless foes with strategic positioning, superior tactics, and bold gambits. Victory isn’t guaranteed, but neither is defeat—be the architect of your triumph.

Test your skill against others in competitive multiplayer games. Can you outlast your rivals in a race to defeat the Warlock, or will you crush them in direct skirmishes? Fortune favors the bold!

The Warlock’s Maze remembers your deeds. Amass achievements, unlock powerful relics, and leave your mark in the Hall of Heroes—or in the ruins of failure. Will you become a hero of legend, or just another forgotten soul?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i5-8250U
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel® UHD Graphics 620
  • Storage: 750 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Please try the Demo before buying if you're uncertain if you can run the game.

short_description: A Warlock has unleashed chaos upon the World of Eld! Lead a band of heroes into his shifting labyrinth in this brutal turn-based dungeon crawler. Outsmart deadly foes, conquer traps, and adapt to ever-changing challenges. Will you emerge victorious or be lost to the maze forever?
